en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped city garden with lawns, flowerbeds, benches and tall trees. In the background stands a two‑storey classical building with a tiled roof and ornate window frames, approached by a central staircase. A fountain or low circular basin is visible in the middle ground. The edges of the card are deckle‑cut. Along the bottom margin there is printed text in Cyrillic script.
